financial_accounting_invariance.claim: NAV = Cash + Marked Holdings + Receivables with zero residual
financial_accounting_invariance.evidence: Verified under instantaneous settlement. However, general balance-sheet identity requires explicit liabilities subtraction: Equity = Assets - Liabilities.

crash_recovery_resilience.claim: Crash tester injected 10 failure points and verified state recovery

provider_contract_rights.claim: Personal/developer tiers legally permit private quantitative modeling and caching
provider_contract_rights.evidence: Based on service marketing overviews. Lacked exact legal contract clause citations and cross-border / exchange entitlement verification.

statistical_protocol_power.claim: 30 defensive observations sufficient to test downside shortfall reduction
statistical_protocol_power.evidence: Power was not evaluated under realistic clustered return variance (sigma 15-25%); MDE and HAC lag selection required formal sensitivity modeling.
